zh: 任务详情支持展开、收起及标题更新动画，打开详情时保留原有内容，减少闪动。
侧边栏新增任务操作菜单、筛选隐藏数量和悬停提示；清除筛选时恢复显示隐藏的子任务。
修复归档任务的父子关系显示，优化问题摘要、统计数字和按钮的显示。
en: Animate task detail sections and title updates, and retain content while opening details to reduce flicker.
Add task menus, filtered-task counts and hover hints to the sidebar; restore hidden subtasks when filters are cleared.
Fix parent-child relationships for archived tasks and refine question summaries, metrics and buttons.
